title: Full Creative Control Within Brief
tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

judge.summary: A polished, colorful animated clip shows a tiny robot tipping a watering can and watering the soil around a sunflower, with no obvious visible problems.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
must_haves.why: One video is provided with a reported duration of 6.6 seconds, approximately the requested length.

must_haves.item: A tiny robot is visibly present.
must_haves.why: A small white-and-blue robot stands beside sunflowers that tower above it.

must_haves.item: A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
must_haves.why: The central flower has prominent yellow petals, a large circular seed head, and a leafy stem.

must_haves.item: The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.
must_haves.why: The robot tips its green watering can, producing visible streams that reach and pool on the soil around the sunflower.
